definitions.explanation: A formal meeting between two people with the purpose of considering marriage, typically arranged through a matchmaker or family members.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勧|すす}められて→勧める：02120_susumeru⟧お{見合|みあ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I had an arranged marriage meeting at my parents' suggestion.

examples.japanese: お{見合|みあ}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}り{合|あ}って→知り合う：03072_shiriau⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We met through an arranged meeting and got married.

examples.japanese: お{見合|みあ}い⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}する→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧。
examples.english: I prepare a photo for the arranged marriage meeting.

notes:
MODERN CONTEXT:
While traditional お{見合|みあ}い arranged by family or professional matchmakers (⟦{仲人|なこうど}→仲人：16691_nakoudo⟧) has declined, modern forms include:
- ⟦{結婚相談所|けっこんそうだんじょ}→結婚相談所：28969_kekkonsoudanjo⟧: marriage agencies
- お{見合|みあ}い⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧: matchmaking parties
- ⟦{婚活|こんかつ}→婚活：05833_konkatsu⟧⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧: dating apps for marriage

TRADITIONAL PROCESS:
1. Exchange of ⟦{釣書|つりがき}→釣書：28970_tsurigaki⟧ (personal profiles)
2. Exchange of photos
3. First meeting (often at a hotel or restaurant)
4. Period of dating to decide

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{見合|みあ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have an arranged meeting
- お{見合|みあ}い⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧: marriage from arranged meeting
- お{見合|みあ}い⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧: prospective partner
